status: bounded CPU evaluation completed; no broad quality qualification or default promotion

sources.original_authors: David Wadden et al., Fact or Fiction: Verifying Scientific Claims, EMNLP 2020

modifications: No dataset text is redistributed. Load exact public corpus/query/judgment bytes by SHA256, select a fixed diagnostic subset and compute independent lexical, trained embedding and conditional rerank metrics.
selection: 24 SHA256-ordered test query ids; all their gold documents + each query's full-corpus TF-IDF top10 +128 SHA256-ordered corpus ids; no model-dependent selection
limits: Reduced corpus includes gold documents, making recall optimistic relative to full BEIR.
No tuning, full benchmark, task-wide quality qualification or performance measurement.
Reranking only reorders embedding top10; missing retrieved relevance remains missing.
Model-native truncation: embeddings256 and query/document pairs512 tokens.
validation: Reproducible public-dataset CPU evaluation tooling is included. Generated query results, ranking metrics, raw reports and local artifact bindings are excluded from this projection.
